name: aygun-tarhan-marder-spacetime-2006
description: S. Aygun, M. Aygun & I. Tarhan's "Energy Momentum Localization in Marder Space Time" (submitted to arXiv as gr-qc/0607102, July 2006) was removed by arXiv administrators for plagiarizing two papers by S.S. Xulu (University of Zululand): Xulu's own PhD thesis "The Energy-Momentum Problem in General Relativity" (hep-th/0308070) and his short paper "Total Energy of the Bianchi Type I Universes" (gr-qc/9910015). Cross-author case (Xulu has no overlap with the Aygun/Tarhan author group) -- not self-plagiarism.
source_quote: This paper has been removed by arXiv administrators because it plagiarizes hep-th/0308070, gr-qc/9910015, and others.
found_by: arXiv administrators (automated/manual text-overlap review); publicized by Peter Woit, https://www.math.columbia.edu/~woit/wordpress/?p=638

papers.title: Energy Momentum Localization in Marder Space Time
papers.note: v1 (24 Jul 2006), the version fetched here -- v3 (22 Aug 2007) is the one arXiv actually withdrew; v1/v2 remain fetchable, v3 does not (404).

papers.title: The Energy-Momentum Problem in General Relativity
papers.note: Xulu's PhD thesis (106 pages) -- a comprehensive review, so any overlap with the 10-page plagiarizing paper is necessarily a small fraction of this document, not near-total overlap.
